name: Actual Roommates Gaiden: The Woman Who Lost Her Cat
source:
Someone from her past has hatched a devious revenge plan to hit her where it hurts the most: they took her cat!

[i]A special short story made to celebrate Actual Roommates' 2nd Anniversary.[/i]

"12 Shots" Lawrence returns for one more adventure, fighting and banging her way through Night City on her path to get back her most loyal companion!

[From [url=https://hanakoxvn.itch.io/actual-roommates-gaiden-the-woman-who-lost-her-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
